briefs.title: Global markets mixed ahead of US open as Nvidia results and lower oil weigh on sentiment
briefs.summary: Valora Analitik reports mixed global markets on Nov. 18, with investors weighing Nvidia's results, AI valuations and the outlook for Federal Reserve policy. briefs.title: Colombia's imports rose 33.7% y/y in September to US$8,192.8 million CIF, DANE data show
briefs.summary: Colombia's imports reached US$8,192.8 million CIF in September 2026, up 33.7% from US$6,128.8 million in September 2025, based on DIAN declarations processed by DANE. Manufactures, at 72.8% of the total, rose 28.6% to US$5,963.2 million CIF, while fuels and extractive products rose 91.2% to US$1,037.1 million CIF. The September trade deficit was US$2,268.2 million FOB, against US$1,135.1 million FOB a year earlier. From January to September, imports totaled US$61,939.1 million CIF, up 19.2%, and the trade deficit was US$16,134.9 million FOB.

briefs.title: BEA: Outdoor recreation was 2.3% of US GDP ($704.2 billion) in 2025; real GDP up 1.9%
briefs.summary: BEA reported that the outdoor recreation economy accounted for 2.3 percent ($704.2 billion) of current-dollar GDP in 2025. Real GDP for the sector rose 1.9 percent, versus 2.3 percent for the overall US economy and 2.5 percent for the sector in 2024. Real gross output rose 2.1 percent, compensation 4.6 percent and employment 1.7 percent. By state, the sector's share of GDP ranged from 6.1 percent in Hawaii to 1.0 percent in the District of Columbia.

briefs.title: Colombia's Q3 2026 GDP grew 0.5%, the weakest in over two years, DANE data show
briefs.summary: DANE reported Q3 2026 GDP growth of 0.5%, below the market forecasts cited by Valora Analitik, which ranged from 0.8% (Grupo Davivienda) to 2.2% (Bancolombia). Oil, gas and mining grew 7.8%, while public spending grew 1.6% versus 10.1% in the second quarter of 2026. Agriculture fell 6.7%, manufacturing 1.2% and financial and insurance activities 0.8%. Imports rose 9.8%, subtracting two percentage points from growth, and household consumption slowed from 2.8% to 1.7%. Analysts cited the August 10, 2026 earthquake among the factors.

es.title: PIB de Colombia creció 0,5 % en el tercer trimestre de 2026, el menor en más de dos años

Petróleo, gas y minería crecieron 7,8 %, mientras que el gasto público creció 1,6 %, frente a 10,1 % en el segundo trimestre de 2026. El agro cayó 6,7 %, la manufactura 1,2 % y las actividades financieras y de seguros 0,8 %. Las importaciones subieron 9,8 % y restaron dos puntos porcentuales al crecimiento, y el consumo de los hogares pasó de 2,8 % a 1,7 %. briefs.title: Fed October minutes: almost all officials see further rate hikes as likely appropriate
briefs.summary: Minutes of the Fed's October meeting, released Wednesday, say almost all participants judged that further increases in the federal funds rate range would likely be appropriate. The FOMC voted 10-2 to hold the range at 3.75%-4%, with Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack dissenting in favor of a quarter-point increase. Officials described AI-related demand as a material source of inflation risk and also voiced concern about financial instability tied to AI-related debt. According to CNBC, markets fully price a quarter-point hike at the Dec. 8-9 meeting.

es.summary: Las actas de la reunión de octubre de la Fed, publicadas el miércoles, indican que casi todos los participantes consideraron que probablemente serían apropiados nuevos aumentos del rango de la tasa de los fondos federales. El FOMC votó 10-2 por mantener el rango en 3,75%-4%, con los votos disidentes de Lisa Cook y Beth Hammack a favor de un alza de un cuarto de punto. Los funcionarios describieron la demanda asociada a la IA como una fuente material de riesgo de inflación y también expresaron preocupación por la inestabilidad financiera ligada a la deuda relacionada con la IA. Según CNBC, el mercado descuenta por completo un alza de un cuarto de punto en la reunión del 8 y 9 de diciembre.

briefs.title: Fed's Waller says a half-point rate hike is probably needed in December
briefs.summary: Fed Governor Christopher Waller told CNBC that a half percentage point rate increase is probably necessary at the Dec. 8-9 FOMC meeting. He said the alternative would be a quarter-point hike with a clear signal of another move in January, an approach Chairman Kevin Warsh has opposed. Waller said the Fed needs to reverse last year's three quarter-point cuts and may need to do more. Other officials have shown a range of views: St. Louis Fed's Alberto Musalem suggested as many as four hikes by spring 2027, while New York Fed's John Williams said he does not think the situation calls for dramatic action.

Watch item 1 and the second unknown use the term 'advance retail and food services' sales. The source never uses 'food services'. It only refers generally to 2026/2027 release dates on the Economic Indicator Release Schedule.

audit.title: Aval Asset Management plans new app and portal by end-2026, expects to take over iColcap ETF

issues: The impact for 'Retail investors and clients of Aval Asset Management' is set to 'mixed', but the source gives no downside. It only describes the goal of lowering access barriers. The draft's own reason says the source gives no usage or cost details, which supports 'undetermined', not 'mixed'.

The actor reason for Aval Asset Management (EN 'According to its president', ES 'Según su presidente') misattributes the stated aim. In the source, the aim to widen the service offering and strengthen its capital-market role is the outlet's own framing, not a statement from Alejandro Gómez. His quote only covers bringing clients closer and letting them see everything and transact in one place.

The ticker 'AVAL' is not in the source. Aval Asset Management is a non-listed subsidiary, so attaching the parent's ticker (NYSE ADR; BVC tickers are GRUPOAVAL/PFAVAL) is unsupported and may suggest a direct effect on the listed parent that the source does not claim.

audit.title: Fed October minutes: almost all officials see further rate hikes as likely appropriate

issues: Actor 'AI-related firms' is labeled 'adverse', but the source only describes a conditional risk. Staff noted that off-balance-sheet leasing and circular financing 'could amplify losses if returns on AI investment were to disappoint.' The source does not say AI firms are being or will be harmed, so the impact should be 'undetermined' or the reason should be reframed as a conditional risk.

Actor 'AI-related firms' reason says 'Staff and officials flagged' concentrated exposures. In the source, staff flagged leasing and circular financing, and only 'a few participants' remarked on concentration. The attribution should be more precise.

Actor 'Borrowers exposed to higher policy rates': the source does not mention borrowers or borrowing costs. The 'adverse' impact is an inference from expected hikes, not stated in the source, and should be framed as conditional on the hikes happening.
Minor ES/EN mismatch: the English title says 'Fed October minutes' but the Spanish title omits 'octubre' ('Actas de la Fed').

audit.title: Colombia sets calendar for consensus minimum wage talks, with first legal deadline Dec. 15

issues: Government actor reason (EN and ES) says the government can call extra sessions 'if the Dec. 15 deadline passes without an agreement'. The source only says the government may call additional extraordinary sessions to seek consensus and does not tie this to the Dec. 15 deadline. Remove the condition.

Summary says the commission 'was formally installed on Nov. 18' (ES: 'se instaló formalmente'). The source lists Nov. 18 only as a scheduled date in the calendar and does not report that the installation took place. Rephrase as 'is scheduled to be formally installed on Nov. 18' or 'the calendar sets Nov. 18 for the formal installation'.

Business owners actor reason adds that the outcome 'would affect their labor costs'. The source does not support this; it only reports their stated position. Limit the reason to the reported position.

Title 'Colombia sets calendar' implies a new decision. The source says the definition is subject to an existing calendar of legal deadlines. Consider rewording, e.g. 'Key dates for Colombia's consensus minimum wage talks'.

Summary says the '2027' increase. The source says 'para el año entrante', which is a reasonable inference from the 2026-11-18 publication date. Acceptable, but consider 'next year's increase' for strict fidelity.
The summary omits the Dec. 16-17 objections window that precedes the Dec. 18-19 review period cited in unknowns. This is optional context, not an error.

audit.title: Fed's Waller says a half-point rate hike is probably needed in December

issues: Actor 'Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh' misattributes the conflict. The draft says 'Waller's proposal runs against Warsh's stated dislike of forward guidance' (ES: 'La propuesta de Waller choca con el rechazo declarado de Warsh...'). The source says only the alternative (a quarter-point hike plus a signal of a January move) runs contrary to Warsh's preference. Waller's main proposal, a 50 bp hike in December, is what he says is needed if the Fed will not signal clearly, so it does not conflict with Warsh's stance.
Actor 'Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh' has impact 'mixed', which the source does not support. Nothing in the source says how Waller's remarks affect Warsh.

Actor 'Fed funds futures market participants' has impact 'mixed', which is not supported by the source. The reason also leaves out that futures already price another move in January and at least one more increase before end-2027.

Actor 'Fed officials favoring gradual tightening (Hammack, Logan, Williams)' groups Williams with Hammack and Logan. The source says only Hammack and Logan endorsed more gradual tightening. Williams said the situation does not call for 'dramatic action' and that the current approach is working well; he did not explicitly endorse gradual tightening.

Watch item 1 states the October minutes 'show how many officials favored further tightening' (ES: 'muestran cuántos funcionarios apoyaban más endurecimiento'). This asserts the minutes' content, which the source does not report. The source says only that the minutes will be released later Wednesday. Rephrase as something to check.
Minor Spanish grammar: 'una alza de un cuarto de punto' should be 'un alza de un cuarto de punto'.

audit.title: Colombian dollar closes at COP 3,356, up COP 52.60, on heavy buying volume
